notes.title: Nora is a bit late, but finally here!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

Nora is (as usual) being a bit of a klutz, so the game got a bit delayed due to some last-minute technical issues.

But, it's finally here and we really hope you like this alternative version of Nora's adventures!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2859820/Nora_In_Search_of_Hidden_Ingredients/

We will also try to release the latest chapter for the original Nora game sometime in early June!

notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3421340/Theres_No_Dragons/
Hi everyone!

The newest addition to our HO collection is out!

Yet again we bring 9 levels with 60 dragons to find on each of them, but this time the task will be slightly more complicated - some dragons are actually hiding behind scenery objects! Please let us know how you like this change.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44910272/1b209cd146fe2f985317e10ed06df7ef053e39a9.png[/img]

notes.title: Where Logic Meets Dexterity
notes.notes:
It's spring and the spring flu is all around. Hep your body to fight the nasty bacteria in our newest game - the Bacterian! Move the red blood cells on top of the nasty viruses to squish them but beware - they are definitely there to get you!

The first 10 levels of Bacterian are now available in the demo.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3570450/Bacterian/

notes.title: Cipheur Goes International
notes.notes:
We've been asked several times to provide translated options for Cipheur, but we decided against it, since many things (like uncommon words) simply can't be translated reasonably while others (like video game quotes) would have "official" translations to other languages the game fans would expect and we might not know. 

However, we decided to provide an alternative and we will be introducing some language packs to Cipheur. Today we are adding 3 Russian DLCs to the game, and the French ones are currently in development. 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3650880/Cipheur__CZitaty_iz_sovetskix_kinofilmov_1/?curator_clanid=45465938

notes.title: A New Beginning for Nora!
notes.notes:
After we first announced the demo of the Nora-themed HO story we've heard people complain there's not enough substance to it and simply placing items in the game locations doesn't give enough of a game.

We've heard you, so Nora: In Search of Hidden Ingredients got her own story now, while still keeping the HO elements. And today we present you a new demo! We'll be happy to hear your opinions!

For those of you waiting on the main Nora story - we are currently working on it and will likely have something to share in 1-2 months!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2859820/Nora_In_Search_of_Hidden_Ingredients/

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44910272/2222e55459f86508394ac1dcf45206909e3ba9bb.png[/img]

notes.title: Welcome Leadlight!
notes.notes:
[b]And the newest addition to our puzzle collection is out![/b]

Can you set up the pixels to create the target image? It can be more tricky than you think, since the puzzle pieces only have 3 colors, while the target images have 6 - so quite some blending is needed!


[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44910272/7ba1a8ba594d09ed6edcd1ab391f4b22ee771605.png[/img]

notes.title: Here Come the Stupid Laws
notes.notes:
...well, maybe not exactly always stupid, but definitely weird. Gathered from all around the world for you to decipher. We hope you like them!

As usual with the new content we're offering one pack for free so you can tell if it's something you like - in this specific case some words will repeat quite often between the puzzles because laws are well... laws.


[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44910272/ec723063eab0041d23860aab1a3cadabe448e96e.png[/img]

notes.title: And We Bring You.. Some Extra Achievements!
notes.notes:
Our first update to Cipheur have landed:

- Added the Nightmare mode and made some changes to the Hard (since people complained some quotes were too short with the previous Hard)
- Also added a tutorial text to explain you can actually close the congratulations popup to make a screenshot if you so wish.
- Finally, introduced achievements for the completion of the free packs (no, we don't plan to add achievements for the paid packs)


Also
- Fixed the double quote in the Videogame Quotes.
- Fixed the Korean language description.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44910272/ec723063eab0041d23860aab1a3cadabe448e96e.png[/img]

notes.title: Tangram Collection Update
notes.notes:
🧩Tangram Collection was updated!🧩

We know it's somewhat overdue, but the long-promised update for Tangram Collection finally landed with a number of key changes:

🧩 All the shapes and puzzle pieces were redrawn from scratch to ensure they fit properly.
🧩 The interface issues (like rotate button not working correctly) were fixed.
🧩 The game now has proper settings allowing.
🧩 Japanese language support was added.
🧩 Achievements were added.

And it's still completely free!
